reuse.why: Adds one guard in the existing link module next to findOrCreateBank and calls it from every provider link function, using the existing db.first helper.

duplication.why: The rule is a single query in assertBankAccountNotLinked; each provider only passes its provider name, account id and upgradingId.

placement.why: accounts/link.ts already holds the bank-link helpers used by the provider link functions, so the link guard belongs there; it runs before any bank or account is created.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, single-purpose helper with an 'id IS NOT ?' clause handling re-linking; new providers still must remember to call it since the link bodies remain separate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link path goes through link.assertBankAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by all five provider link functions in accounts/app.ts.
